metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Hong Kong increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels over Hong Kong, comparing two time periods: 1. February 10-25, 2020 2. April 20-May 12, 2020 For NO2 data, I should use the Sentinel-5P TROPOMI instrument, which provides tropospheric NO2 data. The relevant band is 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'. I need to: 1. Define Hong Kong geometry 2. Get Sentinel-5P NO2 data for both time periods 3. Calculate mean NO2 for each period 4. Compare if the second period increased from the first I should check for: - Empty collections (C1) - Valid pixels after processing (C2) - Valid calculations (C3) For cloud masking, NO2 data from Sentinel-5P doesn't need traditional cloud masking like optical data, but I should check for quality flags if available. Let me structure this: 1. Hong Kong polygon 2. Sentinel-5P collection for NO2 3. Process both time periods 4. Calculate means and compare ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const hongKong = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [113.8, 22.1], [114.5, 22.1], [114.5, 22.6], [113.8, 22.6], [113.8, 22.1] ]); const period1_start = '2020-02-10'; const period1_end = '2020-02-25'; const period2_start = '2020-04-20'; const period2_end = '2020-05-12'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P NO2 const no2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const period1_col = no2_col.filterDate(period1_start, period1_end); const period2_col = no2_col.filterDate(period2_start, period2_end); const period1_size = period1_col.size().getInfo(); const period2_size = period2_col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25) Images: ${period1_size}`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12) Images: ${period2_size}`); // Check for empty collections if (period1_size === 0 || period2_size === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites const period1_mean = period1_col.mean(); const period2_mean = period2_col.mean(); // Check valid pixels const count1 = period1_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const count2 = period2_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 Valid Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2 Valid Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NO2 values const mean1 = period1_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const mean2 = period2_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 Mean NO2: ${mean1 ? mean1.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Period 2 Mean NO2: ${mean2 ? mean2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`); // Validation & Final Answer if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
